ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the image is a distribution table of the planting area of commercial vegetables, with the columns being “Region, 1980, 1999”. In 1980, “suburbs of large cities” was 70%, and “other agricultural areas” was 30%; in 1999, “suburbs of large cities” decreased to 20%, and “other agricultural areas” increased to 80%. Then reason: commercial vegetables are fresh and perishable, and in the past relied more on supply from suburbs close to cities. By 1999, a large amount of planting area had shifted to other agricultural areas that may be farther from cities, indicating that the vegetables from these agricultural areas could also be transported relatively quickly to urban markets. From the perspective of transportation conditions, the reasonable inference is that transportation conditions improved.

method.method_draft: 先读图表：1980年商品蔬菜种植面积主要集中在“大城市郊区”（70%），其他农区只有30%；到1999年，大城市郊区降到20%，其他农区上升到80%。再读题干：要求从“交通条件角度”解释这种分布变化。关键桥梁是商品蔬菜具有鲜活、易腐、面向城市市场销售的特点，过去更依赖靠近城市的郊区供给；如果后来大量转移到距离城市更远的其他农区，说明这些地区也能把蔬菜较快运到消费市场。因此可推断交通条件改善。
